parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end UTC time in ISO 8601 format. If empty, the current time is used.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start UTC time in ISO 8601 format. If empty, the task start time is used.

parameters.name: TrainingJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the training task.

parameters.name: WorkerId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the training task. This parameter is deprecated. Use InstanceId instead.
